requirement.text: The rate-control loop shall execute at 10 Hz with maximum jitter of 5 ms

test_cases.setup: Pump in standard infusion mode with 10 mL/hr infusion
test_cases.steps:
Step 1. Start infusion rate measurement
Step 2. Monitor loop execution frequency over 60 seconds
Step 3. Calculate jitter statistics
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult 1. Average loop frequency is 10 Hz ± 0.1 Hz
ExpectedResult 2. Maximum jitter is less than 5 ms

test_cases.setup: Pump in standard infusion mode with 10 mL/hr infusion, inject fault
test_cases.steps:
Step 1. Inject scheduler stall for 100 ms
Step 2. Verify watchdog detection
Step 3. Check error recovery
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult 1. Watchdog detects stall within 15 ms
ExpectedResult 2. System recovers cleanly

design_docs.name: Rate Control Loop Design
design_docs.description: Detailed design specification for the rate control loop module including timing requirements, error handling, and watchdog implementation

requirement.text: The system shall detect and report all infusion line blockages

test_cases.setup: Pump with 10 mL/hr infusion running, apply complete blockage
test_cases.steps:
Step 1. Apply complete back-pressure to infusion line
Step 2. Monitor pump response
Step 3. Verify blockage detection and reporting
test_cases.expectedResults:
ExpectedResult 1. System detects blockage within 5 seconds
ExpectedResult 2. Error code BLOCK-001 is logged
ExpectedResult 3. UI displays blockage alert
